66a676cab29b3937.description: # Forward Deployed Engineer — Prompt Engineering & Customer Deployments ## Role Overview Huvo AI is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and our product and engineering teams. This role is primarily focused on **prompt engineering, agent behaviour design, testing, and optimisation**, which will constitute approximately **60–70% of the work**. You will design and improve AI voice-agent conversations, qualification logic, objection handling, follow-up flows, multilingual behaviour, and customer-specific instructions. The remaining work involves customer deployments, workflow configuration, integrations, production troubleshooting, and converting recurring customer requirements into scalable product features. This is not a conventional support role. You will own customer implementations from requirement gathering and prompt design to launch, optimisation, and post-launch performance. ## Key Responsibilities * Design, test, and continuously improve prompts for Huvo AI’s voice and conversational agents. * Convert customer sales processes, scripts, FAQs, and business rules into structured AI-agent workflows. * Optimise conversations for qualification, objection handling, site-visit booking, follow-ups, collections, and customer engagement. * Review call recordings, transcripts, outcomes, and failure cases to improve agent performance. * Configure and deploy voice agents, WhatsApp workflows, CRM pipelines, campaigns, dashboards, and reports. * Build integrations with CRMs, Meta lead forms, property portals, telephony systems, WhatsApp APIs, and webhooks. * Troubleshoot prompt, integration, data-flow, and production issues during live campaigns. * Work with customers, founders, and engineers to turn repeated requirements into scalable platform capabilities. * Ensure every deployment is properly tested, documented, measurable, and stable before launch. ## Required Skills * Strong understanding of prompt engineering, LLM behaviour, conversational design, and structured testing. * Ability to translate business requirements into clear prompts, workflows, decision logic, and agent instructions. * Backend or full-stack experience with technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, and REST APIs. * Experience with webhooks, third-party integrations, authentication, databases, logs, and production debugging. * Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers. * High ownership, attention to detail, speed, and testing discipline. ## Good to Have * Experience with AI agents, voice AI, telephony, WhatsApp Business APIs, CRM systems, or sales automation. * Experience evaluating LLM outputs, analysing transcripts, creating test cases, and reducing hallucinations or conversation failures. * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS, Azure, Supabase, or PostgreSQL. * Previous experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, customer engineering, technical consulting, or B2B SaaS. ## Why Join Huvo AI * Work directly with the founder and influence both customer outcomes and product direction. * Build AI agents used by real businesses for sales, lead qualification, follow-ups, collections, and customer engagement. * Develop deep expertise across prompt engineering, voice AI, CRM, WhatsApp automation, and enterprise deployments. * Join at an early stage with the opportunity to grow into AI product, solutions engineering, or engineering leadership.

662fdaff813fa113.description: # Job Description: Quickbase Application Developer & Python Engineer **Company:** Insight Consultants **Role:** Quickbase Application Developer & Python Engineer **Employment Type:** Full-time or Contract (based on experience) **Location:** Bangalore, India ## About the Role Insight Consultants is looking for a hands-on developer to manage, maintain, and continuously improve an existing Quickbase application. This role goes beyond application support. We want someone who can understand business requirements, identify opportunities to improve existing processes, develop new functionality, and use Python to build integrations, automate tasks, and extend the application's capabilities. The ideal candidate combines strong Quickbase development skills with Python programming experience and a practical, problem-solving mindset. They should be comfortable working with an existing application, understanding how it works, and progressively making it more efficient, scalable, and user-friendly. ## Key Responsibilities ### 1. Quickbase Application Management - Take ownership of the existing Quickbase application, including its tables, relationships, forms, reports, dashboards, and workflows. - Maintain and troubleshoot existing functionality, resolve issues, and ensure the application operates reliably. - Manage application enhancements, user access, permissions, and configuration changes. - Review the existing application architecture and identify opportunities to improve performance, usability, and maintainability. - Document application structure, business rules, workflows, and technical changes. ### 2. Application Enhancements and Development - Gather and translate business requirements into practical Quickbase solutions. - Develop new features, forms, reports, dashboards, automations, and workflows. - Improve existing business processes by reducing manual work and eliminating unnecessary steps. - Identify gaps in the current application and proactively recommend improvements. - Test enhancements, troubleshoot defects, and implement changes with minimal disruption to existing operations. ### 3. Python Development and Automation - Develop Python scripts and utilities to automate repetitive tasks and business processes. - Build integrations between Quickbase and other applications, APIs, databases, and data sources. - Use Python to perform data validation, transformation, reconciliation, and bulk data processing. - Develop custom functionality where Quickbase's native capabilities are insufficient or where an external service would be more effective. - Write maintainable, reusable, and well-documented code. ### 4. Integrations and Data Management - Work with Quickbase APIs and REST APIs to exchange data with external systems. - Design and maintain reliable data import, export, synchronization, and integration processes. - Monitor data quality, investigate discrepancies, and implement validation and error-handling mechanisms. - Ensure appropriate handling of credentials, access permissions, and sensitive business data. ### 5. Continuous Improvement - Work with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and improvement opportunities. - Evaluate whether a requirement is best addressed through Quickbase configuration, Python development, or integration with another system. - Recommend solutions that improve productivity, reduce errors, and support future business growth. - Maintain technical documentation and communicate progress, issues, and recommendations clearly. ## Required Qualifications - Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining applications using **Quickbase**. - Proficiency in **Python**, including writing scripts, working with data, debugging, and building automation. - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and API integrations. - Understanding of relational databases, data structures, and data relationships. - Experience troubleshooting existing applications and enhancing functionality without disrupting established workflows. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. - Good communication skills and the ability to work independently. ## Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Quickbase pipelines, formula fields, relationships, reports, and application administration. - Experience with Quickbase API integrations and advanced application customization. - Familiarity with SQL and database concepts. - Experience with Git or other version control systems. - Familiarity with cloud platforms, scheduled jobs, and automated deployments. - Experience with data analytics, reporting, workflow automation, or AI-enabled business applications. ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for a practical, hands-on developer who takes ownership of the application and thinks beyond the immediate task. Someone who asks, "Can this process be made better?" rather than simply implementing the next requested change. The right person will be comfortable working with an existing system, learning its business logic, proposing improvements, and delivering solutions that make a measurable difference to the business.
